reviewer: Coordinator, source-only reading before author-key comparison
method: Read question and full text, excluding expected_disposition, decisive_evidence and rationale. Record independent classifications before comparing the author key. This is a model review, not a human-annotated corpus.
preflight_changes: Clarified the task before launch: universal requirements may already be satisfied; conditional means limited applicability, not merely existing compliance.
Specified supported production 3.x-to-4.0 upgrades, not RC-to-final upgrades; distinguished mandatory consequences of opt-ins from optional advice.
limitations: Synthetic model-authored discussions; not independent human labels or production issues.
Early cases often present a conspicuous authoritative decision; later cases vary chronology/layout. This is routine reading, not adversarial long-context reasoning.
author_key_comparison: All 50 source-only dispositions match. All author rationales subsequently reviewed against the source; no material contradiction found.

preflight.reference_sandbox: 50/50 decisions and valid citations; same read-only sandbox route used for trial grading
preflight.prompt_isolation: A/C: no discovered skill catalogue or answer-key fields; 50 source files each; explicit deployment policy only in C
